subject: Fix use-after-free crash when cluster messages arrive after module unload (#4360)
reason: The fix removes a module's cluster-message receivers when the module is unloaded (moduleUnregisterCleanup -> moduleUnregisterClusterReceivers), preventing a use-after-free when a cluster-bus message of that type arrives afterward and moduleCallClusterReceivers dispatches to the freed module. Reproducing it needs MODULE UNLOAD on a still-running cluster node followed by a cross-node cluster-bus message to the unloaded type. No sanctioned component can do this: valkey.action.commands refuses MODULE LOAD/LOADEX/UNLOAD on both private and deployment instances (and the private-server command except
